description: Shared normalized path length vectors (SPEC.md section 6.2, issue 100). A plaintext path's path_key (SPEC.md section 5: NFC of the case-folded NFD) must be at most 8192 bytes of UTF-8. Normalization can grow a path: U+1D160 (4 bytes) decomposes into three code points of 4 bytes each, which NFC does not recompose, so 683 of them (2732 bytes) have a 8196-byte key. Each vector's path is "path" repeated "repeat" times (once if absent), followed by "suffix" repeated "suffixRepeat" times (once if absent; nothing if "suffix" is absent). Every path here passes the text rule (testdata/paths/text.json) and is vault-relative and new (testdata/paths/validity.json), so "valid" is exactly the normalized length rule. CommitRevision (Go, internal/server/path_integration_test.go) and fitsPathKeyLimit in plugin/src/core/vaultpath (TypeScript, applied before every commit) must return valid exactly as given.
